newsitem.title: CHINA: China central bank warns of illegal fund raising.
newsitem.headline: China central bank warns of illegal fund raising.

text.p: China's central bank has warned of a revival of illegal fund-raising by offering high returns after Beijing cut bank interest rates twice this year, the China Securities newspaper said on Friday.

In a recent investigation, the People's Bank of China found that underground money brokerages had become more and more active in recent months after Beijing cut interest rates in May and August, it quoted a central bank spokesman as saying.
"Any case of such illegal money raising and loan activities will not be protected by the law," the spokesman said. "Investors should know the risk."
"To most investors, bank deposits are the safest way of investment with stable returns," he was quoted as saying.
Finance in China is completely under state control, with no private banks allowed. Any form of money raising through private channels is banned by law.
